products.body:
08B-3 roller chain is a 12.7mm pitch triplex (triple-strand) metric roller chain made per ISO and British Standards. As a triple-strand roller chain, it is engineered to operate in demanding applications that other strand widths would be incapable of. What makes our 08B-3 roller chain special is the use of high-grade alloy and carbon steel materials per component and processes like heat-treating and shot peening done to each component before assembly. The chain is also factory pre-loaded to reduce significantly or eliminate initial and long-term elongation. Stacking up these features produces an 08B-3 chain that is more capable and has a superior lifespan than others available. This chain is supplied as a 10ft box, including one connecting link. We also provide 08B-3 roller chain sprockets and tools for making replacement or repairs easier. For additional information or to request a quote for our tier one 08B-3 chain, contact our customer service team, and we will be happy to assist you!

08B-3 Chain Dimensions


  • Part #: 08B-3
  • Pitch (P): 12.70mm
  • Roller Width (R): 7.75mm
  • Roller Diameter (D): 8.51mm
  • Overall Width (W): 44.90mm
  • Connecting Link Overall Width (X): 48.80mm
  • Plate Height (H): 11.56mm
  • Plate Thickness (T): 1.58mm
  • Pin Diameter (L): 4.44mm
  • Minimum Breaking Load: 4,850 KGS
  • Weight: 2.0 kG/ m

Experience the DUROCHAIN Difference.

DUROCHAIN Premium #08B-3 metric roller chain is built for dependable power transmission, smooth operation, and extended service life in demanding industrial applications. Manufactured to applicable ISO and British Standards, this chain provides accurate dimensional compatibility with metric roller chain systems and components.

Featuring a 12.70mm pitch, DUROCHAIN #08B-3 metric roller chain is a reliable choice for industrial machinery, conveyor systems, material handling equipment, packaging machinery, agricultural equipment, and other power transmission applications requiring consistent performance.

Built for rock-solid reliability and extended service life, every DUROCHAIN #08B-3 roller chain is manufactured using premium carbon steel components, through-hardened pins, solid bushings, solid rollers, quad-staked rivets, precision-prepared plate holes, and factory-applied lubrication to help improve strength, wear resistance, shock-load capability, and overall operating performance.

Need help selecting the right metric roller chain, sprockets, or accessories for your application? Contact Us — our team is here to help.

DUROCHAIN Premium #08B-3 Metric Roller Chain Features

Through-Hardened Pins

DUROCHAIN pins are through-hardened for increased strength, improved wear resistance, and dependable performance throughout the service life of the chain.

Solid Bushings & Rollers

Precision solid bushings and solid rollers provide smooth bearing surfaces that help reduce internal friction, resist deformation, and improve overall wear life.

Superior Plate Hole Preparation

Precision-prepared plate holes help promote accurate component fitment, reduce stress points, and improve fatigue resistance in demanding power transmission applications.

Max Contour Side Plates

Max contour side plates are designed to add strength where it matters while maintaining ANSI dimensional requirements for proper interchangeability.

Quad-Staked Rivets

High-hold quad-staked rivets help improve chain integrity, side-load capability, shock-load resistance, and dependability in demanding industrial applications.

Factory Preload

Factory preloading helps properly seat chain components before installation, reducing initial elongation and helping the chain settle in faster once placed into service.
